seo.titulo: Social media analytics and reports for your clients | Clipfine
seo.descripcion: Metrics for every clip on TikTok, Reels, Shorts and Facebook, a summary per client and a PDF report ready to send. For agencies that want contracts renewed.

bajada: Clipfine reads the metrics of every published clip, network by network, and builds each client's summary. Export it as a PDF and walk into the meeting with numbers.

p1.p: Can I send my client a report?
p1.r: Yes. Each client's summary exports as a PDF to send them, as CSV for Excel or Sheets, or as Markdown for Notion, Slack or an email.

p2.p: Which metrics does each network provide?
p2.r: Views, likes, comments, shares, saves, reach and followers gained where the network provides them, and retention where it shares it. Facebook only shares views, likes and comments.

p3.p: Do I have to enter the numbers by hand?
p3.r: No. Clipfine reads the metrics on its own an hour after posting, after 6 hours, after a day and so on up to 90 days later.
